texts.label: text
texts.orig: Figuring out your flywheel, and getting it moving, take time. Don’t worry if you can’t figure it out, or if you aren’t seeing a flywheel in your business. Oftentimes, leaders only figure out their flywheel after the fact – I doubt Jeff Bezos had this diagram in mind when he started Amazon, and Netflix certainly didn’t (i.e. they had no intention of going digital when they launched).
